question: Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited Bangladesh in March 2021 in connection with the commemoration of three events. Which of the following is NOT one of them?

options.text: 50 years of Bangladesh’s war of liberation.
Birth centenary of Sheikh Mujibur Rahman
10 years of signing of the India-Bangladesh Land Boundary Agreement (LBA)
50 years of the establishment of diplomatic ties between India and Bangladesh

solution:
The correct answer is __**10 years of the signing of the India-Bangladesh Land Boundary Agreement (LBA).**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Prime Minister Narendra Modi held talks with his Bangladesh counterpart, Sheikh Hasina, in Dhaka__ on 27 March 2021.
 
• This visit is in connection with the commemoration of three events:
 __
 
• 50 years of Bangladesh’s war of liberation.
 
• Birth centenary of Sheikh Mujibur Rahman.
 
• 50 years of the establishment of diplomatic ties between India and Bangladesh.
 
 
 
• Hence 10 years of the signing of the India-Bangladesh Land Boundary Agreement (LBA) is an incorrect statement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• India and Bangladesh also signed several MoUs following the talks.
 
• Delegation level talks were also held before the signing of agreements.
 
• The two leaders virtually inaugurated some development projects today.
 
• PM Modi also visited Bangabandhu Mausoleum Complex in Tungipara.
 
• Bangladesh: 
 
 
• Capital - Dhaka.
 
• Currency - Bangladeshi Taka.
 
• President - Abdul Hamid.
 
• Prime Minister - Sheikh Hasina.
